criteria.text: `pnpm typecheck` passes with `Source` including `'juridico' | 'oficial' | 'nicho'` and `collectors: Record<Source, Collector>` registering all three (compile-time; not independently runtime-testable, verified by running `pnpm typecheck` directly, green on the diff).

`src/collectors/index.ts`'s `collectors.juridico`, `.oficial`, `.nicho` are each `typeof === 'function'`; `defaultSources` **includes** all three (`assert.ok(defaultSources.includes('juridico'))` etc.), so `pnpm ingest` with no arguments runs them.

Each of `src/collectors/juridico.ts`, `oficial.ts`, `nicho.ts`, read as source text, imports `fetchFeed` from `../rss.js` (or `./rss.js`), calls it once per feed URL, and contains no bespoke `fetch(` or XML parsing of its own — structural regex assertions on the file text, mirroring `camara-acceptance.test.ts:22-32`.

Each new collector called with `[]` returns a resolved `Promise` of `[]` with zero thrown/logged errors and no network call (assert via elapsed time under e.g. 50ms, mirroring `senado-independent-acceptance.test.ts`'s AC2 pattern) — collectors are integration code and tests never hit the network, so this is checked by never invoking them with real feed URLs and instead exercising the empty-persons short-circuit if one exists, or by asserting the returned `RawDoc[]`'s `source` literal via static analysis of the file text (`source: 'juridico'` etc.) when the collector has no early-return branch to test without a live fetch.

`tonedSources` (`src/store.ts`) stays exactly `['gdelt', 'gkg']`; a doc inserted with `source: 'juridico'|'oficial'|'nicho'` and a numeric `tone` in its `RawDoc` literal lands with `tone: null` in the `docs` table (mirrors `camara-acceptance.test.ts` AC6).
`parseSourceList('juridico')` resolves to `'juridico'`; `parseSourceList('juridico,oficial,nicho')` resolves to `'juridico,oficial,nicho'` unchanged order-preserved-post-dedupe.
`parseRisingQuery({ source: 'oficial' }).source === 'oficial'` and `parseTimelineQuery({ source: 'nicho' }).source === 'nicho'` (not `'all'`) — the risk this spec calls out in section 3.

`SOURCE_SEGMENTS.find(([v]) => v === 'juridico')` equals `['juridico', 'jurídico']` (same for `oficial`, `nicho`), and driving each through `createHandlers({...}).source('juridico')()` calls `setSource`/`load`/`updateHeader` in that order — mirrors `camara-acceptance.test.ts` AC14, proving the new options reuse the shared handler with no bespoke wiring.

Adding the three new fixture docs (one per family, see 7) requires zero changes to any pre-existing pinned literal elsewhere in the suite — a diff-shape criterion verified by running the full pre-existing suite (graph/signature/timeline/tone/rising/...) unmodified alongside the new fixture docs and confirming every pinned assertion still holds.
A fixture doc from each new source tags exactly the person its text names, with `tone: null`, `source` equal to its own family — same shape as `camara-acceptance.test.ts` AC10.

`README.md`'s `source=all|...` enumeration is updated identically in all four places it's spelled out (graph, docs, rising, timeline) to include `juridico|oficial|nicho` after `senado`, and documents the three new collectors (feed lists, that they are part of `defaultSources`, and the RDF/Planalto exclusion) in prose next to the existing `camara`/`senado`/`rss` paragraphs.

`pnpm ingest juridico oficial nicho` against a scratch `DATA_DIR` (never the same directory as a running server, per `CLAUDE.md`) completes without throwing on at least one real run performed by the builder before opening the PR, and the PR description records, for one person with existing volume (e.g. a Supreme Court justice) and one without: total doc count and the top-5 `sort=pmi` terms before the new collectors ran and after — a manual, human-checkable step, not a `pnpm test` assertion, satisfying the "ranking still makes sense" question the issue raises. A green `pnpm test` suite alone does not satisfy this criterion.
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` are both green with no other route, SQL statement or `sort=pmi` formula literal touched (`git diff` against `src/graph.ts:163,165` is empty).
